name: Senjuin Mahiro
source:
[b]The delinquent gyaru heiress.[/b]

Asuka's younger sister. Not brother, sister.
Rejects the established traditions of her strict buttoned-up family.
Doesn't really want to dress as a woman, so she chooses to dress as a delinquent as a form of passive protest.
Refuses to accept the notion that cross dressing actually suits her well, and her choice of attire has merely made her into a cute gyaru.
Gets along with Iori as a fellow outsider and supported her decision to quit cross-dressing.
Admires Iori as a sempai for standing up for her beliefs.
Is reluctant to admit it, but owes a lot to her older sister Asuka.

[From [url=https://no-strike.jp/yuribatake/character-en/]Official Website[/url]]
